entries.name: Stewart toroid K3 / 2Q3(S3) (original family variant)
entries.sourceClassification: Original 2-mouth member of the documented four-mouth octahedral excavation construction; numerical Stewart criteria verified. Not asserted as a named benchmark entry.

chirality.scope: Complete incidence-preserving symmetry/chirality search is not claimed.

construction.definition: Truncated octahedron excavated by a central regular octahedron with triangular cupola mouths on a tetrahedral set of hexagon facets.
construction.genusDerivation: A connected spherical outer boundary and connected spherical excavation boundary, each with m cap disks removed and paired, give Euler characteristic 4-2m and genus m-1.

topology.genusScope: Abstract supplied boundary; geometric self-intersection is not excluded.

D.method: Complete convex-face pair plane-line interval checks and coplanar closed polygon clipping; shared source edges/vertices retained.

numericChecks.scope: Numerical R/A/Q/T/D for this supplied ordinary regular-faced positive-genus boundary; no exhaustive Stewart catalog or exact certificate.
